name: China Telecom Zhongshan Huoju Cloud Data Center
notes: Commercial data-center directories list a China Telecom Zhongshan Huoju Cloud colocation facility in Zhongshan; no rack count or power figure was found.

name: Zhongshan Unicom Changjiang North Road IDC
notes: IDC service listing describes the Zhongshan Unicom Changjiang North Road Unicom Building fifth-floor IDC as a five-star IDC data center at No. 6 Changjiang North Road; capacity not disclosed.

name: Zhongshan Huoju IDC / Ruijiang Technology Huoju data center
notes: Local IDC article says the Huoju facility was Ruijiang Technology Group's first self-built South China data room, built to China Telecom five-star IDC standards, with phase-one 250 racks and phase-two 300 racks; source is a secondary service article.

name: China Telecom Guangdong Zhuhai IDC Data Center
notes: Data-center directories list China Telecom's Guangdong Zhuhai IDC at 199 Jinfeng Middle Road, Xiangzhou; DC Atlas estimates 5 MW live capacity.

name: China Telecom Zhuhai Xinxiangzhou IDC Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists a China Telecom Zhuhai Xinxiangzhou IDC facility at Xianghua Road 210, Xiangzhou; power and rack details not disclosed.

name: Zhuhai Telecom Information Building IDC
notes: IDC service pages describe the Zhuhai Information Building IDC on the eighth floor of the China Telecom information building at Xianghua Road, built to China Telecom four-star IDC standards with public IDC rooms, Zhuhai government IDC rooms, and Flextronics colo area.

name: China (Xilin) Commercial Big Data Center
developer: Xilin County / Huawei / China Unicom partners
notes: State media and Xilin County procurement pages identify the China (Xilin) Commercial Big Data Center; China News reported in 2021 that the Xilin commercial big data center had been completed and put into use.

name: Baise Mobile green low-carbon data center / information center
notes: China News Guangxi reports China Mobile Guangxi Baise Branch built a green low-carbon data center/information center and reduced PUE to 1.352; facility scale not disclosed.

name: JD Cloud (Beihai) Cloud Computing Big Data Center
notes: CCTV/China Daily coverage of the JD Beihai project says a 100-rack transition room was complete and land for a 3,000-rack big data center had been acquired with design/construction underway. Capacity estimated as 3,000 standard 5 kW racks where planning references use standard racks.

name: Beihai Mobile Shanghai Road Data Center
notes: Guangxi Data Center Development Plan (2020-2025) lists Beihai Mobile Shanghai Road Data Center with 240 standard racks among data centers above 100 racks.

name: China-ASEAN Information Harbor Beibu Gulf Cloud Computing Center
notes: Guangxi Data Center Development Plan (2020-2025) lists the China-ASEAN Information Harbor Beibu Gulf Cloud Computing Center in Beihai with 20,000 planned standard racks; later construction evidence was not found in this pass.

name: Zhuangmei Guangxi / Chongzuo Cloud Computing Big Data Center
developer: Chongzuo municipal digital government / Huawei Cloud partners
notes: China News and People's Daily Guangxi describe Chongzuo's cloud computing big data center as a core component of the digital Chongzuo architecture; People's Daily reported a 2022 expansion to more than 260 servers and allocated Kunpeng/X86 cloud resources.

name: Chongzuo Mobile Data Center
notes: Guangxi Data Center Development Plan (2020-2025) lists Chongzuo Mobile Data Center with 640 standard racks.

name: Chaozhisuan (Chongzuo) AI computing base phase I
notes: Energy-review reposts cite Chongzuo Development and Reform Commission approval for a 15,785.94 sq m computing center in Pingxiang Industrial Park with 148 16 kW cabinets, 2,606 PFlops, planned construction from August 2026 to December 2027; capacity is cabinet power only.

name: Fangchenggang Administrative Center Complex Data Center
notes: Guangxi Data Center Development Plan (2020-2025) lists Fangchenggang Administrative Center Complex Data Center, operated by Guangxi Telecom, with 300 standard racks; capacity estimated at 300 x 5 kW standard racks.

name: Guigang Big Data Center Project
notes: Trade press reports a Guigang Big Data Center cooperation signing with about CNY 500 million investment, 21,000 sq m building area, and 1,200 standard 5 kW racks; capacity derived from 1,200 x 5 kW.

name: Guigang Mobile data center room
notes: CCTime reported Guigang Mobile conducted energy-saving variable-frequency air-conditioning upgrades at its data center room; scale and power not disclosed.

name: Guilin Huawei Cloud Computing Data Center / Huawei Cooperation Zone Data Center phase I
developer: Guilin Economic Development Zone / Huawei partners
notes: Guilin TV reported the Huawei cloud computing data center planned up to 10,000 racks and had built two data-room buildings; IDCQuan later reported phase I entered operation in January 2021 with 876 racks and GB50174-2017 A-level certification.

name: Guilin Huawei Cooperation Zone Data Center phase II
developer: Guilin Economic Development Zone / Huawei / Bornsales and partners
notes: Trade and partner sources report phase II started construction with about CNY 619 million investment, 2,352 racks, and more than 3,000P computing capacity; rack power not disclosed.

name: ASEAN (Bama) Big Data Cloud Computing Base phase I
notes: People's Daily Guangxi said the Hechi investment project expected to enter production in early 2023 and aimed to build Guangxi's first public-cloud big-data supercomputing platform; DTDATA reports phase I passed completion acceptance with 40,900 sq m, one data-room building, and 4,000 racks.

name: Hechi Mobile Shangren Big Data Center
notes: Xinhua Guangxi reports Hechi Mobile's Shangren Big Data Center is Hechi's first mobile internet data center room, with 358 cabinets, supporting local cloud-computing and data-analysis platforms.

name: Hezhou Pinggui Big Data Cloud Computing Ecological Technology Industrial Park phase I data center
notes: Pinggui District government project disclosure says phase I covers about 24 mu and includes a big data center with IDC storage rooms able to hold 3,500 cabinets; broader plan covers about 1,106 mu.

name: China Mobile Guangxi Hezhou Data Center
notes: Hezhou News reports China Mobile Guangxi Hezhou Data Center is the city's largest operational data center by installed capacity, with final planned capacity of 1,114 cabinets and 8,000G outbound bandwidth.

name: Guangxi first source-grid-load-storage data center / Hezhou computing project
notes: People's Daily Guangxi reports Guangxi's first source-grid-load-storage data center started construction, planned with three data-center buildings totaling 67,100 sq m and 7,515 5 kW cabinets; phase I includes 500 intelligent-computing cabinets and 1,025P computing capacity. Capacity derived from 7,515 x 5 kW.
